significance: The Divya Desam of Thirukannapuram in Nagapattinam district, second only to Srirangam in the number of Alvar hymns addressed to its presiding deity.
story: When a hair was found in a garland offered by the priest Rangabhatta, Vishnu is said to have appeared wearing a wig - sowri - to shield his devotee from blame, earning the name Sowriraja.
